periodScope: Unbranded around-2000 Japanese residential balcony interpretation. Dimensions and construction are modeling assumptions, not a replica or claim about a specific historical SKU.

ownerSearch.result: Current persistent inventory contained no air-conditioner condenser, refrigerant trunking or condensate hose asset owner; new coherent BalconyACSet owner created.

assets.manufacture: Assumed folded/baked-powder-coated sheet-steel enclosure with separate front panel, fan guard, molded PP fan, aluminum heat exchanger, service panel, fasteners, valves and elastomer isolation pads.
components: front panel with real circular opening
assets.mounting: Floor-standing outdoor condenser on two rails and rubber pads. Rear face assumes a ventilated gap to wall; wall brackets and anchors are not silently implied.
assets.interfaces: Front fan opening is geometric, not a black decal. Guard gaps are open. Side louvers are individual geometry. Copper stubs terminate at service side for later connection to refrigerant lines. Internal refrigeration circuit, motor wiring, pressure containment and fan rotation are not simulated.
assets.orientationExposure: Y-up; front fan faces outward; top/front upper faces receive sun/rain, wall-side rear is sheltered, bottom pan/feet are splash/contact zones. No scene-specific directional weathering baked yet.
assets.aging: Warm-off-white coating and modest roughness represent maintained outdoor age without arbitrary rust, painted shadows or fake highlights. Lower-edge dirt, coil dust and UV chalking require placement-specific masks later.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Fan opening, guard, blades, fins, louvers, seams, valves, pipes, feet and screws are geometry. Powder-coat grain, fine metal microstructure and wipe detail are deterministic PBR texture/normal signals.

assets.manufacture: Assumed exterior PVC snap-cover trunking with hollow rounded shell, separate front cover/clip bands, molded lower elbow and two insulated line ends.
assets.mounting: Wall-mounted service cover. Fasteners/substrate are excluded until wall construction owner is known.
assets.interfaces: Hollow section and cover seam are geometric. Lower elbow connects to horizontal run; insulated line pair remains separate and protrudes at service end.
assets.orientationExposure: Vertical wall run with lower elbow toward condenser. Sun-exposed outer cover; wall-side surfaces sheltered.
assets.aging: No arbitrary yellow streaks or grime. Warm ivory base and roughness only; UV fade/chalking remains scene-causal pending.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Shell cavity, cover seam, clips, elbow, horizontal cover and line pair are geometry. Fine PVC grain is material.

assets.manufacture: Assumed flexible corrugated PVC drain hose with real wall thickness and one retaining clip.
assets.mounting: Starts below the condenser and slopes toward floor drainage; exact destination must follow the benchmark drain location.
assets.interfaces: Outer and inner corrugated skins form a true hollow tube with annular end faces. No blocked solid cylinder or painted corrugation.
assets.orientationExposure: Floor-adjacent route with sag. Lower segment is splash/dust exposed; upper segment is partially sheltered by condenser.
assets.aging: No algae or water stain asserted. Slightly muted PVC color/roughness only until drain use and wet state are established.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Corrugation and hollow bore are geometry; micro-scratches/grain are material.

materials.microstructure: painted internal chassis grain; not a fake shadow
